fieldType.description: The value's type. In a contract (`customProperties` entry): `kort_tekst` (short text) a string, a list of strings with `isMultiSelect`; `lang_tekst` (long text) a string; `tall`/`decimal` (number) and `int` (integer) a YAML number (7, not "7"; a stored value that isn't a number stays text); `dato` (date) `YYYY-MM-DD`; `timestamp` `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM`; `klokkeslett` (time of day) `HH:MM`; `boolean` true/false; `person` the person's name; `kildesystem` (source system) its name, a list of names with `isMultiSelect`; `nedtrekksmeny` (dropdown) one of `dropdownOptions`, a list of them with `isMultiSelect`; `tabell` (table fields only, `entityTypes` `tableType`) another table's name, a list of names with `isMultiSelect`; `kolonne` (column fields only, `entityTypes` `column`) the name of another column of the same table, a list of names with `isMultiSelect`; `kolonnereferanse` (relationship fields) `table.column`; `radliste` (relationship fields) a list of maps, one per row; `beregning` (column fields only, `entityTypes` `column`) a calculation as a map: `kloss` (the building block), `kolonner` (the columns it reads, each `table.column`), `valg` (its other choices), `betingelser` (the conditions of the `naar` block) or `sql` (the `fri` block). Absent = `kort_tekst`.

odcsTarget.description: Admin-declared ODCS contract slot at the field's level; absent or "customProperties" = the customProperties blob.

odcsPropertyName.description: The customProperties `property` name for this field; absent = the field key.

suggestible.description: Whether a suggestion («Foreslå endringer») may change the field's value; absent = true.

description.description: Plain-text help text shown next to the field wherever it is filled in; absent = none.

labelEn.description: English name of the field, shown when the UI is in English; absent = use `label`.

defaultValue.description: Single-select dropdowns: the option new columns, and empty table fields when a table gets a type, are given in Specly; absent = none.

columnSources.description: `kolonnereferanse`: where the column choices come from (`fromTable`, `upstream`, `toTable`).

subFields.description: `radliste`: the sub-field definitions of a row.

appliesToTableTypes.description: Table type names. A relationship field shows only on relationships whose `from` table has one of them; a `tabell` field offers only tables of them. Absent = every table type.

maxValues.description: Governance: at most this many values (multi-select dropdowns; `field.maxValues:<key>`). Absent = no limit.

parentFieldDefUuid.description: Governance: the `key` of the field whose value this field's options belong under (`field.parent:<key>`). Absent = none.

optionParents.description: Governance: option -> the parent field's options it is allowed under; an option without an entry is allowed under any. Absent = none.

deprecationCondition.description: Governance: the field may be filled only on a deprecated table/column, or must be filled there. Absent = no condition.

phasingOut.description: Governance: the field is being phased out — still allowed, a filled value is a warning (`field.phasingOut:<key>`). Absent = false.

phasingOutNote.description: Why the field is being phased out, or what to use instead. Absent = none.

V3ConfigMetadataFieldDefinition.description: `metadata_field_definitions.json` entries have no `name` — `label` is display text, `key` is the stable handle a table type's `columnFieldDefUuids`/`metadataFieldDefUuids` reference.

V3MetadataFieldType.description: A metadata field definition's `fieldType`: what its values are and how a contract writes them.
